title_vi: Game còn nhiều lỗi, đang trong quá trình sửa lỗi và sẽ sớm update
body_vi: The game still has several bugs; fixes are currently underway, and an update will be released soon.
title_en: An update has been released to fix the bugs that were bothering you.
body_en: I have received the error reports. Thank you very much.
